title: Anjani Putra
desc: Heir Viraj battles gangster Bhairava, who aims to seize his family's land illegally, sparking violent enmity and bloodshed.

title: Ennodu Modhi Paar
desc: Forced by circumstances, peace-loving businessman Karthikeya intervenes in law enforcement after his sister witnesses a murder. Yet, his own dark past resurfaces, unsettling him.

title: Maapillai Seenu
desc: Deep in debt, Seenu and his uncle Narasimha flee to Chennai but end up in a different city. They discover Narasimha's resemblance to the local don and exploit it to their advantage.

title: Hello
desc: Avinash risks all to reconnect with Priya-join his pursuit!

title: Frienda Pola Yaaru Machaan
desc: Abhi and Vasu are two friends who have been inseparable since their childhood. However, their friendship is affected when they meet a beautiful woman.
Kapil Dev becomes the captain of the Indian cricket team at the 1983 Cricket World Cup, aiming to make his country proud on the global stage.

title: Sattapadi Kutram
desc: An advocate faces many obstacles to fight against corrupt senior government functionaries, rampant tax evasion and god-men who sexually exploit their disciples.

title: Naalai
desc: Childhood friends turned gangsters work for Nair, an underworld mafia lord. When mistrust brews, Nair replaces them, sparking a dangerous rivalry.

title: Renigunta
desc: Five young boys escape from Madurai's juvenile jail and stop at a place called Renigunta on their way to Mumbai. They come across a man who helps them connect with underworld gangsters.

title: Vai Raja Vai
desc: Karthik's precognition ability leads to trouble when he uses it for gambling.

title: Kaaka Muttai
desc: Two brothers from a slum try to get pizza from a new shop but are shooed away by the watchman.

title: Jagame Thandhiram
desc: Kind-hearted gangster Suruli ventures to London, entangled in crime. Matters intensify when he falls for singer Attila, raising stakes in his tumultuous life.

title: Ivan Veramadhiri
desc: Guna kidnaps Eeswaran, brother of a minister for orchestrating violence among students. After being released, Eeswaran trails after Guna to exact his revenge.

title: Sangaththalaivan
desc: Textile worker Rangan, initially wary of Communist Sivalingam, aligns with them after facing exploitation by his employer.

title: Kaatru Veliyidai
desc: Indian pilot Varun Chakrapani reflects on his past romance with Leela while being held as a prisoner of war during the Kargil War with Pakistan.

title: Kongu Nattu Raja
desc: Thangam and her boyfriend Rajavel embark on an adventurous mission to rescue Muthurathina Boopathy, the Zamindar, from his scheming concubine Amutha, reuniting him with his wife.

title: Ithu Enga Area
desc: Hari and Karthika fall in love with each other but are distraught when they find they are from different castes. However, they decide to fight for their relationship and parents' approval.

title: Kolaigaran
desc: DCP Karthikeyan arrests former IPS officer, Prabhakaran, after he confesses to a murder. But when he investigates further, Karthikeyan learns a shocking truth that troubles his conscience.
